asset_heavy.reason: Operates hydroelectric plants, diesel generation, power lines, and fiber and microwave networks across 40+ remote Alaska communities.

big_ticket.reason: Monthly electricity, internet and phone bills are small and frequent.

cyclical_demand.reason: Electricity, internet and phone are essential utility services that customers keep in a downturn.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are households and small local businesses in remote villages; some large commercial bulk power buyers exist.

offers_products.reason: Sells utility service (power, broadband, phone), not goods; Plume WiFi pods are included with plans.

offers_services.reason: Regulated electric utility plus broadband and telephone service to Alaska communities.

people_delivered.reason: Service depends on power plants, lines and fiber networks, not mainly staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: Customers pay monthly for ongoing electricity, internet and phone utility service.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Residential customers buy home electricity, fiber internet and phone service.

sells_to_organizations.reason: AP&T Business Services sells business internet, dedicated access and bulk power to commercial customers.
